sql: WITH weekly_thurs AS ( SELECT y.trip_date, y.trips, d.d_day_name, h.holiday_name, h.is_national FROM whybot.yellow_daily y JOIN TPCDS_DB.date_dim d ON d.d_date = y.trip_date LEFT JOIN whybot.us_holidays h ON h.holiday_date = y.trip_date WHERE d.d_dow = 4 AND y.trip_date BETWEEN DATE '2024-11-01' AND DATE '2024-12-31' ), thurs_stats AS ( SELECT trip_date, trips, d_day_name, holiday_name, is_national, AVG(CASE WHEN trip_date <> DATE '2024-11-28' THEN trips END) OVER (PARTITION BY NULL) AS baseline_avg_thurs FROM weekly_thurs ) SELECT trip_date, trips, d_day_name, holiday_name, is_national, CASE WHEN trip_date = DATE '2024-11-28' THEN trips ELSE NULL END AS target_trips, CASE WHEN trip_date <> DATE '2024-11-28' THEN baseline_avg_thurs ELSE NULL END AS baseline_avg_thurs FROM thurs_stats ORDER BY trip_date LIMIT 500
